content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user with a personal task list","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed and revert a Completed task back to Open","so_that":"the status of each task on my list reflects its current state","business_description":"Users track progress on their personal tasks by changing a task's status between Open and Completed. The status change is stored by the backend, and the frontend shows the new status only after the backend confirms the change.","business_value":"Keeps task status accurate across the task list and the reporting views, so the Open and Completed counts reflect what the user has actually done.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"a task with status Completed exists","when":"the user reverts the task to Open","then":"the backend stores the status Open and the task list shows the task with status Open"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Open or Completed","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the backend saves the change","then":"the Completion Date field of the task is populated with the time of the change"}],"edge_cases":["Marking a task that is already Completed as Completed again: the PRD does not state the expected result; this needs a decision (reject, accept without change, or accept and update the Completion Date).","Reverting a task that is already Open to Open: the PRD does not state the expected result; this needs a decision.","The PRD does not state whether the Completion Date is cleared when a Completed task is reverted to Open; this needs a decision.","The PRD does not state whether the status change is a separate action from the general edit form or whether it is the same action; this story covers only the status change endpoint and the status control.","A status change request sent for a task ID that does not exist must return a not found error and must not create a task.","A request with a missing status value must be rejected as a missing mandatory field error."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["Status change endpoint accepts Open and Completed as the only allowed values and returns the updated task.","Marking a task as Completed sets the Completion Date field; the behaviour on revert is documented and implemented as decided.","Error responses for task not found, invalid input and missing status are returned and tested.","Frontend shows the new status only after the backend confirms success; a failed request leaves the previous status displayed with an error message.","Automated tests cover marking as Completed, reverting to Open, and each error case.","Open questions in the edge cases are answered by the product owner and recorded in the story."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"status-change-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add status change endpoint to set a task to Completed or Open","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an endpoint that changes the status of one task to Open or Completed and returns the updated task. When the status becomes Completed, populate the Completion Date field.
